sections.indications_and_usage: Directions Adults and children over 2 years: tear open packet, unfold and use as a wash cloth. Allow hands to dry without wiping.
sections.dosage_and_administration: Uses : Clean and refresh hands without soap and water.
sections.warnings_and_cautions: Warnings ■ For external use only. ■ Do not use on broken skin. ■ Do not use in eyes. If this occurs, rinse thoroughly with water. ■ Stop use and ask a doctor if irritation or redness develops and persists for more than 72 hours. ■ Keep out of reach of children. If swallowed, call a Poison Control Center or get medical help right away.
